findings.summary: A stale event source revision is reported as repository cross-scope, so the contract does not provide the separately required stale-revision refusal.
evidence: eng/github-substrate-v2-units.json GS2-07.2 exitGate separately requires cross-scope and stale-revision refusals.

src/FS.GG.Coordination.Qualification.Contracts/GitHubNarrowReconciliationQualification.fs:111-114 combines repository and source-revision mismatches into CrossScope and uses StaleRevision only for non-positive subject revisions.
eng/validate-github-narrow-reconciliation.fsx:91 mutates SourceRevision for the independent scope control and checks only Result.isError, allowing the wrong CrossScope finding to pass as green.
resolution_evidence: Worker repair is required before acceptance: distinguish repository cross-scope from event source-revision staleness and assert the exact typed findings.

findings.summary: Most refusal controls prove only that some error occurred, so incorrect or collapsed refusal classifications satisfy the advertised mutation-discriminating gate.
evidence: tests/FS.GG.Coordination.UnitTests/GitHubNarrowReconciliationTests.fs:48-59 uses Result.isError for unknown, malformed, stale, cross-scope, and conflicting-subject cases; only incomplete and altered-routing assert exact findings.
eng/validate-github-narrow-reconciliation.fsx:43-47,56-62 and 73-77,90-97 likewise accept Result.isError for most generated and independent refusal controls.

The exact Q3 validator still prints GITHUB_NARROW_RECONCILIATION_OK while the stale-source mutation at validator line 91 is classified as CrossScope by implementation lines 111-112, demonstrating an observable false-green path.
resolution_evidence: Worker repair is required before acceptance: make generated and independent controls assert the intended finding class and add focused exact-result tests for every registered refusal family.

findings.summary: The SDD task ledger still declares every implementation and evidence obligation pending despite the candidate claiming a completed first green implementation/evidence loop.
evidence: work/299-gs2-07-2-narrow-reconciliation/tasks.yml:31-140 records T001 through T011 with status pending and owner sdd.
readiness/299-gs2-07-2-narrow-reconciliation/analysis.json remains implementationReady and names analysis.next.implement rather than verified or shipped evidence.

The tracked candidate evidence directory contains contract.json and two control inventories, but the current SDD source ledger has no completed task ownership or bound EV001-EV011 evidence dispositions.
resolution_evidence: Worker repair is required before acceptance: complete the task ledger with the real worker identity and bind generated test evidence through verify/ship after the code and controls are repaired.
